note: Set A is more accurate on dimensions and locations, correctly extracting the 1-inch thickness of the PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 plate and placing the threaded rod in the correct context, whereas Set B misreads the plate thickness as 1/2 inch and incorrectly locates the rod at Detail A3 instead of B1. Set A does misclassify C3X6 (a channel) as an angle and loosely binds an angle section to the column cap plate, but these errors are fewer than Set B's multiple dimensional and location mistakes. Set B also infers a weld size from a plate dimension without explicit textual support.
